title: Gen 2 Draft
content:
<!-- wp:html -->
<style>#gen2frame{position:fixed;inset:0;width:100vw;height:100vh;border:0;z-index:2147483000;background:#0e1a16}body.admin-bar #gen2frame{top:32px;height:calc(100vh - 32px)}html,body{overflow:hidden!important}</style><iframe id="gen2frame" title="Recycleworks Gen 2 draft" srcdoc="<!doctype html><html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"><meta name="robots" content="noindex,nofollow"><title>Recycleworks Gen 2</title>
<meta name="claude:viewport-fit-sides" content="cover">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Archivo:wght@500;700;800&family=Source+Sans+3:ital,wght@0,400;0,600;1,400&display=swap">
<style>
/* Layout: full-bleed photo bands, left-aligned type, one accent (RWI blue) + one working green; cards only for division tiles. */
:root{
  --bg:#f6f7f5; --bg2:#ffffff; --ink:#15211d; --ink2:#4b5a54; --line:#d9dfdb;
  --blue:#1e99d6; --blue-ink:#0f6c9a; --green:#3b8a3f; --green-ink:#2b6b2f;
  --dark:#0e1a16; --dark-ink:#e8eee9; --dark-ink2:#a9b8b0;
  --display:"Archivo",system-ui,sans-serif; --body:"Source Sans 3","Segoe UI",system-ui,sans-serif;
  --gutter:max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-left,0px)); --gutter-r:max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-right,0px));
}
@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]){--bg:#0e1a16;--bg2:#162621;--ink:#e8eee9;--ink2:#a9b8b0;--line:#2a3a34;--blue:#49b4e8;--blue-ink:#8fd2f3;--green:#5fb463;--green-ink:#9ad99d;color-scheme:dark}}
:root[data-theme="dark"]{--bg:#0e1a16;--bg2:#162621;--ink:#e8eee9;--ink2:#a9b8b0;--line:#2a3a34;--blue:#49b4e8;--blue-ink:#8fd2f3;--green:#5fb463;--green-ink:#9ad99d;color-scheme:dark}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--body);font-size:17px;line-height:1.55}
body::before{content:"";position:fixed;inset:0 0 auto;height:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);z-index:10;background:var(--dark)}
img{max-width:100%;display:block}
a{color:var(--blue-ink)}
h1,h2,h3,h4{font-family:var(--display);line-height:1.08;text-wrap:balance;margin:0}
h1{font-size:clamp(2.2rem,5.6vw,4.2rem);font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.02em}
h2{font-size:clamp(1.7rem,3.4vw,2.6rem);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.015em}
h3{font-size:1.25rem;font-weight:700}
p{margin:0}
.wrap{max-width:1180px;margin:0 auto;padding-left:var(--gutter);padding-right:var(--gutter-r)}
.eyebrow{font-family:var(--display);font-size:.78rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--green-ink)}
.band{padding-block:clamp(48px,7vw,96px)}
.band.alt{background:var(--bg2)}
.band.dark{background:var(--dark);color:var(--dark-ink)}
.band.dark .eyebrow{color:var(--green)}
.band.dark p{color:var(--dark-ink2)}
.lead{font-size:1.2rem;max-width:62ch;color:var(--ink2)}
.band.dark .lead{color:var(--dark-ink2)}
.stack{display:grid;gap:18px}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-family:var(--display);font-weight:700;font-size:.95rem;letter-spacing:.02em;padding:13px 20px;border-radius:4px;text-decoration:none;border:2px solid transparent;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .12s ease}
.btn:hover{transform:translateY(-1px)}
.btn:focus-visible,a:focus-visible,button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--blue);outline-offset:3px}
.btn.primary{background:var(--blue);color:#fff}
.btn.ghost{background:transparent;color:inherit;border-color:currentColor}
.btn.green{background:var(--green);color:#fff}
/* draft banner */
.draft{background:#ffd54a;color:#1a1a1a;font-family:var(--display);font-size:.82rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;text-align:center;padding:7px var(--gutter)}
/* header */
header{position:sticky;top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);z-index:9;background:var(--dark);color:var(--dark-ink);border-bottom:1px solid #223129}
.nav{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;min-height:64px}
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;text-decoration:none;color:inherit;font-family:var(--display);font-weight:800;font-size:1.15rem;letter-spacing:-.01em;margin-right:auto}
.brand .mark{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;background:conic-gradient(var(--blue) 0 33%,var(--green) 33% 66%,#7cc4e8 66% 100%);position:relative}
.brand .mark::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:9px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--dark)}
.brand b{color:var(--green)}
.links{display:flex;gap:4px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.links a{color:var(--dark-ink);text-decoration:none;font-family:var(--display);font-weight:500;font-size:.92rem;padding:8px 10px;border-radius:4px}
.links a:hover,.links a[aria-current="page"]{background:#1f2f29;color:#fff}
.phone{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:700;color:#fff;text-decoration:none;white-space:nowrap}
.menu-btn{display:none;background:none;border:1px solid #3a4a44;color:#fff;border-radius:4px;padding:8px 10px;font-family:var(--display);font-weight:700}
@media (max-width:900px){.links{display:none;width:100%;flex-direction:column;padding-bottom:10px}.links.open{display:flex}.menu-btn{display:inline-block}.nav{flex-wrap:wrap}.phone{display:none}}
/* hero */
.hero{position:relative;color:#fff;min-height:min(78vh,720px);display:grid;align-items:end;overflow:hidden;background:var(--dark)}
.hero img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center 72%}
.hero::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(14,26,22,.15) 0%,rgba(14,26,22,.35) 45%,rgba(14,26,22,.92) 100%)}
.hero .wrap{position:relative;z-index:1;padding-block:56px 44px;display:grid;gap:18px}
.hero p{color:#dbe5df;font-size:1.2rem;max-width:58ch}
.hero .cta{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(150px,1fr));gap:1px;background:var(--line);border:1px solid var(--line)}
.stat{background:var(--bg2);padding:18px 18px 16px}
.stat .n{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:800;font-size:2.1rem;letter-spacing:-.02em;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:var(--blue-ink)}
.stat .l{font-size:.9rem;color:var(--ink2)}
/* division tiles */
.tiles{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(230px,1fr));gap:18px}
.tile{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-rows:180px auto;background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--line);text-decoration:none;color:inherit;overflow:hidden;border-radius:6px}
.tile img{width:100%;height:180px;object-fit:cover;transition:transform .3s ease}
.tile:hover img{transform:scale(1.04)}
.tile .t{padding:16px 18px 20px;display:grid;gap:8px}
.tile .t span{color:var(--ink2);font-size:.95rem}
.tile .t em{font-style:normal;color:var(--blue-ink);font-family:var(--display);font-weight:700;font-size:.9rem}
/* two column */
.cols{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr .95fr;gap:40px;align-items:center}
.cols>*{min-width:0}
@media (max-width:820px){.cols{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.photo{border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden;aspect-ratio:4/3;max-width:100%;background:var(--line)}
.photo img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.photo.tall{aspect-ratio:3/4}
.photo.wide{aspect-ratio:16/9}
/* process */
.steps{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(220px,1fr));gap:26px}
.step{display:grid;gap:8px;padding-top:14px;border-top:3px solid var(--green)}
.step small{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:700;color:var(--green-ink);letter-spacing:.1em;font-size:.75rem}
/* list grid */
.facts{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(240px,1fr));gap:22px 36px}
.fact h3{margin-bottom:6px}
.fact p{color:var(--ink2)}
.band.dark .fact p{color:var(--dark-ink2)}
ul.plain{margin:0;padding-left:20px;display:grid;gap:6px}
/* tables */
.tbl{overflow-x:auto}
table{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;font-size:.97rem}
th,td{text-align:left;padding:10px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);vertical-align:top}
th{font-family:var(--display);font-size:.8rem;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink2)}
/* logo wall (category only) */
.wall{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(170px,1fr));gap:12px}
.wall div{border:1px dashed var(--line);border-radius:6px;padding:18px 12px;text-align:center;font-family:var(--display);font-weight:700;color:var(--ink2);font-size:.9rem}
/* quote form */
.form{display:grid;gap:14px;background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--line);padding:24px;border-radius:6px}
.form .row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px}
@media (max-width:620px){.form .row{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
label{display:grid;gap:5px;font-size:.9rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink2)}
input,select,textarea{font:inherit;padding:11px 12px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:4px;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);width:100%;min-width:0}
textarea{min-height:110px;resize:vertical}
.ok{display:none;padding:14px;border-left:4px solid var(--green);background:var(--bg)}
.ok.show{display:block}
/* quotes */
.quotes{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(260px,1fr));gap:22px}
.q{padding:20px;border-left:3px solid var(--blue);background:var(--bg2)}
.q p{font-size:1.05rem}
.q small{display:block;margin-top:10px;color:var(--ink2);font-family:var(--display);font-weight:700}
/* page header */
.ph{padding-block:clamp(40px,6vw,72px) clamp(24px,4vw,40px);display:grid;gap:12px}
.ph .wrap{display:grid;gap:12px}
/* footer */
footer{background:var(--dark);color:var(--dark-ink2);padding-block:48px 32px;font-size:.95rem}
footer .grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.4fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:30px}
@media (max-width:820px){footer .grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
@media (max-width:520px){footer .grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
footer h4{color:#fff;font-size:.85rem;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:10px}
footer a{color:var(--dark-ink);text-decoration:none}
footer a:hover{text-decoration:underline}
footer ul{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:grid;gap:6px}
.copy{margin-top:30px;padding-top:16px;border-top:1px solid #223129;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;font-size:.85rem}
.copybtn{background:none;border:1px solid #3a4a44;color:#fff;border-radius:4px;padding:3px 8px;font:inherit;font-size:.8rem;cursor:pointer;margin-left:6px}
/* pages */
.page{display:none}.page.on{display:block}
.note{font-size:.85rem;color:var(--ink2);border-left:3px solid #ffd54a;padding:8px 12px;background:var(--bg2)}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{transition:none!important;scroll-behavior:auto!important}}
</style>

</head><body><div class="draft">Gen 2 draft · private review · nothing here is live on recycleworksinc.com</div>

<header>
  <div class="wrap nav">
    <a class="brand" href="#home"><span class="mark" aria-hidden="true"></span>Recycle<b>works</b></a>
    <button class="menu-btn" id="menuBtn" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="links">Menu</button>
    <nav class="links" id="links" aria-label="Primary">
      <a href="#organics">Organics</a>
      <a href="#commercial">Commercial Organics</a>
      <a href="#destruction">Product Destruction</a>
      <a href="#liquid">Bulk Liquid Hauling</a>
      <a href="#solutions">Solutions</a>
      <a href="#service-area">Service Area</a>
      <a href="#about">About</a>
      <a href="#careers">Careers</a>
      <a href="#quote" class="q-link">Get a Quote</a>
    </nav>
    <span class="phone">781-340-9425</span>
  </div>
</header>

<main>

<!-- ============ HOME ============ -->
<section class="page" id="p-home">
  <div class="hero">
    <img src="/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/rwi-gen2-hero-sunset.jpg" alt="Recycleworks organics truck at the end of a route, dusk">
    <div class="wrap">
      <span class="eyebrow" style="color:#9ad99d">Food &amp; beverage waste · New England and the Northeast</span>
      <h1>Nothing we pick up goes to a landfill.</h1>
      <p>Recycleworks hauls, de-packages and recycles organic waste for grocers, food producers, beverage brands and towns. One fleet, one invoice, 100% diversion, 30+ years in Braintree.</p>
      <div class="cta">
        <a class="btn primary" href="#quote">Get a quote</a>
        <a class="btn ghost" href="#organics">See how it works</a>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="wrap" style="margin-top:-1px">
    <div class="stats" aria-label="Key figures">
      <div class="stat"><div class="n">100%</div><div class="l">of collected material diverted from landfill</div></div>
      <div class="stat"><div class="n">45+</div><div class="l">trucks on the road, GPS-tracked and camera-equipped</div></div>
      <div class="stat"><div class="n">40,000+</div><div class="l">tons of organics handled per year <span class="note-inline" title="Placeholder — replace with Routeware August × 12">*</span></div></div>
      <div class="stat"><div class="n">7</div><div class="l">states served: MA · RI · NH · CT · VT · NY · NJ</div></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="band">
    <div class="wrap stack">
      <span class="eyebrow">Five divisions</span>
      <h2>Pick the one that matches your waste stream.</h2>
      <p class="lead">Every division runs on the same promise: we show up, we weigh it, we send you the diversion report, and none of it goes in the ground.</p>
      <div class="tiles" style="margin-top:10px">
        <a class="tile" href="#organics"><img src="/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/rwi-gen2-organics-1.jpg" alt="Organics collection truck"><div class="t"><h3>Organics</h3><span>Food waste collection for grocery, restaurants, campuses and food producers. Carts, totes and dumpsters on a route.</span><em>Organics →</em></div></a>
        <a class="tile" href="#commercial"><img src="/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/rwi-gen2-rolloff-green.jpg" alt="Roll-off truck with open-top container"><div class="t"><h3>Commercial Organics</h3><span>High-volume and off-spec: warehouse clean-outs, packaged food, roll-offs, trailer loads and plant byproducts.</span><em>Commercial Organics →</em></div></a>
        <a class="tile" href="#destruction"><img src="/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/rwi-gen2-pd-pallets.jpg" alt="Pallets of beverage product staged for destruction"><div class="t"><h3>Product Destruction – Beverage</h3><span>Secure, certified destruction of out-of-code or recalled beverage. Cans, bottles, kegs, mixed pallets.</span><em>Product Destruction →</em></div></a>
        <a class="tile" href="#liquid"><img src="/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/rwi-gen2-liquid-1.jpg" alt="Stainless tanker truck"><div class="t"><h3>Bulk Liquid Waste Hauling</h3><span>Tanker and vac service for process water, wash water, expired liquids, grease and brewery/dairy byproducts.</span><em>Bulk Liquid →</em></div></a>
        <a class="tile" href="#solutions"><img src="/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/rwi-gen2-fleet-dock.jpg" alt="Recycleworks tractors at the Braintree dock"><div class="t"><h3>Solutions</h3><span>Program design, compliance reporting, cardboard and packaging recycling, dedicated trucks and equipment.</span><em>Solutions →</em></div></a>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="band alt">
    <div class="wrap cols">
      <div class="stack">
        <span class="eyebrow">The waste bans are the law</span>
        <h2>If you make more than half a ton of food waste a week in Massachusetts, it can't go in the trash.</h2>
        <p class="lead">Massachusetts, Connecticut, Rhode Island, Vermont, New York, New Jersey and New Hampshire all ban commercial food waste from disposal above a threshold. Recycleworks is the compliant outlet: scheduled pickup, weight tickets, and a diversion report your auditor accepts.</p>
        <a class="btn green" href="#service-area">Check your state's threshold</a>
      </div>
      <div class="photo"><img src="/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/rwi-gen2-organics-3.jpg" alt="Recycleworks organics truck"></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="band dark">
    <div class="wrap stack">
      <span class="eyebrow">How it works</span>
      <h2>Three steps, one vendor.</h2>
      <div class="steps" style="margin-top:12px">
        <div class="step"><small>COLLECT</small><h3>Our trucks, our drivers</h3><p>Route trucks for carts and totes, roll-offs for volume, tankers for liquid, tractor-trailers for pallets. Every truck is GPS-tracked with cameras front and rear.</p></div>
        <div class="step"><small>PROCESS</small><h3>De-package in Braintree</h3><p>Packaged product is opened, separated and dewatered in our fenced, camera-monitored facility. Cardboard, plastic and aluminum are baled for recycling.</p></div>
        <div class="step"><small>RECOVER</small><h3>Energy and soil, not landfill</h3><p>Organics go to anaerobic digestion for renewable energy or to permitted composting. You get a certificate of destruction or a diversion report, by weight.</p></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="band">
    <div class="wrap stack">
      <span class="eyebrow">Who we work with</span>
      <h2>Regional grocers to national brands.</h2>
      <div class="wall" aria-label="Customer categories">
        <div>Supermarket chains</div><div>Beverage &amp; bottling</div><div>Food manufacturers</div><div>Breweries &amp; distilleries</div><div>Cold storage &amp; 3PL</div><div>Universities &amp; hospitals</div><div>Municipalities</div><div>Restaurants &amp; hospitality</div>
      </div>
      <div class="quotes" style="margin-top:14px">
        <div class="q"><p>"The packaged food program has saved us a tremendous amount of time and hassle. They show up on time and solve problems for us."</p><small>General Manager, regional grocery chain</small></div>
        <div class="q"><p>"One-stop option for all of our unwanted product. The service is top notch and they help us stay under budget."</p><small>Facility Manager, national bottling company</small></div>
        <div class="q"><p>"Flexible solutions and service quality have saved our company time and money."</p><small>General Manager, national refrigerated storage company</small></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="band alt">
    <div class="wrap cols">
      <div class="stack">
        <span class="eyebrow">Get a quote</span>
        <h2>Tell us what you generate. We'll price it this week.</h2>
        <p class="lead">Most quotes go out within two business days. If you're under contract elsewhere, tell us the end date and we'll schedule the switch so there's no gap in service.</p>
        <p>Or call <strong>781-340-9425</strong> · info@recycleworksinc.com</p>
      </div>
      <form class="form" id="quoteHome" novalidate>
        <div class="row">
          <label>Company <input id="qh-co" name="company" required></label>
          <label>Your name <input id="qh-name" name="name" required></label>
        </div>
        <div class="row">
          <label>Email <input id="qh-email" type="email" name="email" required></label>
          <label>Phone <input id="qh-phone" type="tel" name="phone"></label>
        </div>
        <div class="row">
          <label>Service <select id="qh-svc" name="service"><option>Organics (food waste)</option><option>Commercial Organics (volume / packaged)</option><option>Product Destruction – Beverage</option><option>Bulk Liquid Waste Hauling</option><option>Solutions / not sure</option></select></label>
          <label>Site ZIP <input id="qh-zip" name="zip" inputmode="numeric"></label>
        </div>
        <div class="row">
          <label>Approx. volume per week <input id="qh-vol" name="volume" placeholder="e.g. 6 carts, 2 tons, 3 pallets"></label>
          <label>Current contract ends <input id="qh-end" type="month" name="contract_end"></label>
        </div>
        <label>Anything else <textarea id="qh-msg" name="message"></textarea></label>
        <button class="btn primary" type="submit">Request quote</button>
        <div class="ok" id="qh-ok">Got it. A Recycleworks rep will reply within two business days. (Draft site: nothing was sent.)</div>
      </form>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- ============ ORGANICS ============ -->
<section class="page" id="p-organics">
  <div class="hero" style="min-height:min(56vh,520px)">
    <img src="/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/rwi-gen2-organics-2.jpg" alt="Recycleworks organics truck at a warehouse" style="object-position:center 60%">
    <div class="wrap"><span class="eyebrow" style="color:#9ad99d">Division · Organics</span><h1>Food waste collection on a route.</h1><p>Carts, totes and dumpsters for grocery, restaurants, campuses, hospitals and food producers across New England, New York and New Jersey.</p><div class="cta"><a class="btn primary" href="#quote">Get a quote</a></div></div>
  </div>
  <div class="band"><div class="wrap cols">
    <div class="stack">
      <span class="eyebrow">What we take</span>
      <h2>Everything that was food.</h2>
      <ul class="plain">
        <li>Pre- and post-consumer food scraps, produce, deli, bakery, meat and seafood trim</li>
        <li>Packaged food in cases, totes or on pallets (we de-package in Braintree)</li>
        <li>Coffee grounds, FOG-free kitchen waste, floral</li>
        <li>Certified compostable serviceware where the end site accepts it</li>
      </ul>
      <p class="lead">Containers: 64-gal carts, 2–8-yard dumpsters, 240-gal totes, or a dedicated compactor. Frequency from weekly to daily.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="photo"><img src="/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/rwi-gen2-organics-4.jpg" alt="Organics truck tipping a cart"></div>
  </div></div>
  <div class="band alt"><div class="wrap stack">
    <span class="eyebrow">What you get</span>
    <div class="facts">
      <div class="fact"><h3>Weight-ticket reporting</h3><p>Every pickup is weighed on the truck. Monthly diversion reports by site, in tons and CO₂e, formatted for MassDEP, LEED and corporate ESG filings.</p></div>
      <div class="fact"><h3>Contamination feedback</h3><p>Drivers photograph contaminated loads. You see it the same day, by store, so training goes where it's needed.</p></div>
      <div class="fact"><h3>Start-up without downtime</h3><p>Containers, signage and staff training delivered the week before go-live. We schedule around your current hauler's contract end.</p></div>
      <div class="fact"><h3>Where it goes</h3><p>Permitted anaerobic digesters and compost sites across the Northeast. Renewable energy and finished soil, never landfill.</p></div>
    </div>
  </div></div>
  <div class="band dark"><div class="wrap cols">
